answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops a gale of fake agents. Each agent posts a 100-credit bond that anchors its identity to a record, then the bond decays 5% every epoch unless honest work renews it. A faker launching 1,000 identities must lock 100,000 credits up front and keep topping them up as they rot, while an honest agent pays once and stands on the knoll of earnings, its bond refreshed by real jobs. Fakes bleed money; honest work pays.
